entries.zh: 主管、主持；时刻勤谨照看。
entries.en: to oversee; to take charge of; to watch over with constant care.
entries.notes: H 栏仅录「主」字，M 栏三音（chū y. cû.）疑为「主意顾」一类复词，未能完全对应。

entries.zh: 上下仔细看顾、前后照看。
entries.en: to watch over by keeping an eye on everything; to look things over from head to tail.
〔damaged in original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L、M 两栏空缺，H 栏字形难辨（龟/电），R 栏仅存 xiêng lī 二音，不足定夺。

entries.en: diligent and watchful; to strive with care.
entries.notes: H 栏「龟/电勉」当为「黾勉」（勤勉），M、R 两栏读音与「黾勉」不尽相合。

entries.en: to manage affairs; to attend to business.
entries.notes: L 栏词条残缺；H「吏司」当为「理事」之音写，M、R 皆读 lī-su/lī-sin。

entries.en: to look after; to tend and protect.
entries.notes: H 栏「省顾」疑为「看顾」之误录，M「cùa cou」、R「cān cǔ」均合「看顾」音。

entries.zh: 任凭他、由他去（不加干涉）。
entries.en: to let him be; to leave it to him.
entries.notes: L 栏末语「celebre guſa」费解（疑谚语或人名残文），与汉栏「任伊」不相照应。

entries.en: to be anxious about; to keep thinking of.
to be concerned about; to care for.
to favour and look after; to cherish.
entries.notes: M、R 两栏皆读 kuan-kòu，与「爱顾」音不合，疑 H 栏或为「关顾」。

entries.zh: 掌管家业、总揽一切（「掌世界」喻掌管全部家业）。
entries.en: to have charge of the whole estate; to manage everything.
entries.notes: L 栏「ra ices」疑为「raíces」（根基），指家业根本；R 栏末音「guang」与「界」不合。

entries.en: to grasp and hold; to keep control of.
entries.notes: M 栏中有一残字，且 L 栏「ponderandoſe」（反复权衡）与「把持」辞意不尽合。

entries.en: to hold fast; to uphold.
entries.notes: M 栏中有一残字，M、R 音节数亦不一致。

entries.en: to keep to; to hold fast to.
to hold a deed or contract.
entries.notes: R「chĭt guī」与「执圭」音合，H 栏作「契」，字形与读音有歧，未详孰是。

entries.zh: 把定、牢牢握住；坚定不摇。
entries.en: to hold firmly; to be firm and sure.
entries.notes: M 栏中有一残字，M、R 音节数亦不一致。

entries.en: to take care of oneself; to protect one's health.
to nourish and care for the body; to look after one's health.
to nurse; to regulate one's health.
to take good care of oneself; to cherish one's health.

entries.zh: 周旋、应酬往来；妥善应对。
entries.en: to deal with; to attend to matters; to move among people.
entries.notes: L 栏「haftaccarlo」疑为「hasta acabarlo」（直至完成），辞意与「周旋」不尽合。

entries.zh: 治家、操持家务（节俭持家）。
entries.en: to manage one's household; to keep house thriftily.
entries.notes: L 栏「capa」疑为「casa」之误，H「作家」即「做家」治家之义。

entries.en: 〔damaged in original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏残缺、M 栏全缺，H 栏「卒/率」难辨，R 仅存 guī ý 二音，语义无法定夺。
